R1.mechanism: PortCall = AbortSignal + the monotonic instant it fires. Built-in store: no pool wait/transaction once cancelled; Prisma maxWait and transaction timeout capped by the time remaining at the call (no fresh window); after acquiring the connection the remaining time is re-read and set as SET LOCAL statement_timeout, so SQL blocked on a lock is cancelled by PostgreSQL at the deadline; the signal/deadline is re-checked after the statement and before COMMIT, so cancelled work rolls back; the promise settles only after commit/rollback (no write left running). Dispatcher passes the same deadline as its abort timer; reads pass the claim read deadline.
R1.preserved: possible invocation stays OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (never NOT_DISPATCHED); no port retry; owned late-fact continuation unchanged; the residual ambiguous window is between the last check and the COMMIT acknowledgement

R2.diagnosis: conflict and stale facts change no stored state, so state-based replay detection cannot see them; no existing column can hold their observation without exposing IDs; the committed audit row itself is the only durable fact receipt available without a migration
R2.mechanism: every fact audit row gets a deterministic ID: HMAC-SHA256(key = attempt token for create facts / claim nonce for read results, canonical {dto action-fact/1, event, attemptId, ticketId | ordinal+outcome}) in UUIDv8 layout. Conflict/stale publications look the ID up under the request -> attempt -> ordinal locks: already committed -> no-op (IDENTICAL / STALE, no audit); otherwise one audit row. Success facts keep their state guards and now also carry the stable ID. Metadata allowlist unchanged.
R2.properties: first audit retained; distinct facts audited once each; survives a new client/process (durable row); audit failure and known rollbacks leave no receipt so the retry records once within PUBLICATION_ATTEMPTS=3; the ID is a keyed PRF of private material never exposed (no ticket/candidate/nonce/token/hash, nor an unkeyed digest)

residualRisks: Prisma 6.19 has no query-cancel API: an abort that precedes the deadline cannot interrupt a statement already blocked; it is cut at the deadline by statement_timeout at the latest and never commits (pre-COMMIT check).
The window between the last pre-COMMIT check and the COMMIT acknowledgement remains genuinely ambiguous and is reported as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN by design.
The Prisma transaction timeout is capped at the remaining time measured before the pool wait; the effective bound after a pool wait is the in-database statement_timeout plus the pre-COMMIT check.
Fact receipts rely on deterministic audit-row IDs (no migration); a reviewer should confirm that a keyed digest of private capability material as an audit primary key satisfies the privacy rule.
Wall-clock deadlines are exercised with bounded real waits; exact boundary instants are not deterministically tested.
MOCK evidence only; nothing about vendor wire behavior or production readiness is claimed.
